definitions.api_endpoints: FastAPI route decorators (@router/@app .get/.post/.put/.patch/.delete) in apps/api/main.py and apps/api/routers/*.py.
definitions.api_routers: Python modules in apps/api/routers that declare at least one route.
definitions.db_tables_orm: __tablename__ declarations in apps/api/models.py (migration-only tables not counted).
definitions.modules_listed: Entries in the /health module list of apps/api/main.py.
definitions.modules_spec: Highest module number in the /health module list (MOD-01 … MOD-NN).
